text: {"lessons":["Selling B, D, and E after gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on expected risk and return, not the satisfaction of locking in a profit.","I tend to judge each stock against my purchase price; I should assess each holding objectively rather than avoid selling simply because it is at a loss.","I rarely trade, and the account’s small fluctuations so far do not show that past price moves predict what comes next; I should stay patient and avoid overreacting."]}
